limitations: Equivalence is relative to all saved old three-source candidates at the same root, not native candidates that were never exported.
Different-function status uses complete SAT verdicts with no care clauses; no DRAT or independent proof kernel used.
No old candidate at a root is absence in this archive, not a theorem about every possible expression.
No area credit: actual product requires full certificate, free root-difference witness, same-set exact removal and independent DSEC.

protocol.bound: Uniform 1000 conflicts/query and 120 seconds/case, one process per case, no retries.
protocol.interpretation: No candidate selected-area or optimizer claim; unknown/timeout cannot prove functional novelty. Roots without old candidates are separately labelled.
proof_order: exhaustive independent union external-support truth equality (only a sufficient alias condition)
free original-graph recipe XOR recipe SAT for every remaining pair
protocol.scope: All 50 new exact free-SAT recipes compared to every old three-source candidate at the same root on the same original free PI/RO graph.
